title: Debug a stuck population
summary: A friend's run learns nothing. Find the bugs one at a time, and end up with the Intermediate preset.

steps.title: Does everyone move?
steps.body:
A friend trained this script for 100 generations and nothing happened. Seekers stand still and every chart is flat. It is a copy of the Intermediate preset with a few bugs in it.

Work like a detective. Measure, find a clue, fix one thing, then measure again.

Start with the basics: does every player move? Press Check. The test match measures how far the seeker walks, and the answer is not far at all. A seeker that never moves scores exactly what every other seeker scores, so evolution has nothing to choose from. Read the `each tick` block and ask which players run each line.

check.message: The seeker should walk at least 5 m in the test match.

hints: Lines inside if agent.isHider { } only run for hiders.
Move the act line and its comment out of the if, to just above it.

steps.title: Is there a signal?
steps.body:
Everyone moves now, but hiders still do not learn. Press Check. It trains for one generation and reports the best hider's score, which is not above 0.

A hider that stays hidden should earn points, so one of the hider's rewards must never pay. Read each condition and ask when it can be true.

check.message: The best hider should score above 0.

hints: agent.hidden is only true after prep, while the seeker is looking.
Remove and agent.prep from the hider's first reward.

steps.title: Do the points add up?
steps.body:
The rewards are meant to be zero sum, so in every match the two teams' points should add up to exactly 0. Press Check: the test match says they add up to minus 9.

Nine is a clue. It is the length of prep in seconds. Find the reward that keeps counting during prep, while the seeker is frozen and blind.

check.message: The hider's and the seeker's points should add up to 0.

hints: agent.prep is true during prep. Only one seeker reward can fire then.
Change the seeker's penalty to reward -1 * dt when not agent.prep and not agent.seesOpponent.

steps.title: Nothing new is born
steps.body:
The rewards are fixed. The last bug hides in the generation block. Your friend's fitness chart crept up for a few generations, then went flat for good.

Read the `breed` line. Every mutation chance is 0, so children can only remix their parents' weights. Once the best mix is found, nothing new can appear.

Turn mutation back on with the usual chances, then press Check. It compares your script with the Intermediate preset and shows the first line that still differs. When they match, you have rebuilt the preset from a broken copy.

check.message: Your script should do exactly what the Intermediate preset does.

hints: The usual chances are weights 0.8, addConnection 0.05, addNode 0.03 and toggle 0.01.
Change the line to breed(crossover: 0.75, mutate: { weights: 0.8, addConnection: 0.05, addNode: 0.03, toggle: 0.01 }).
